messages:
maya: Heads up — got renewal invoice from Customer X for their private on-prem deployment. Invoice INV-2026-045 shows a recurring 'Platform Management Fee (Private)' line at $45,000/yr but contract PX-903 lists $30,000/yr + $15,000 one-time migration. attaching: https://drive.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-045.pdf
InvoiceBot: New invoice INV-2026-045 uploaded to finance drive by maya.
ben_ledger: I pulled the invoice. Line item table: `Platform Management Fee (Private) - 12 months - $45,000`; `Support - Enterprise - $12,000` — but contract PX-903 (signed 2024-06) shows Support: Standard. No signed amendment found in CLM.
maya: Customer claims they agreed to 'Advanced Observability + Enterprise support' during renewal call, but I can't find a signed amendment or PO.
erin.finance: On contract search: PX-903 only. No amendment, no signed SOW. Were there any sales notes or email confirmations?
sam-support: Customer opened ticket yesterday asking about renewal. Our agent mentioned Enterprise features to help justify costs but didn't capture an acceptance or change order. I can pull the ticket transcript.
maya: This looks like either billing error (migration rolled into recurring) or an unapproved upsell. CFO wants exposure calc for Q2 close. Ben, can you estimate delta and potential credit?
ben_ledger: Quick calc: overcharge = $45k - $30k = $15k annual. If we prorate remaining term (8 months) that's ~$10,000. Separately, usage true-up: Monitoring shows Dedicated GPU hours 1.2x committed in Jan–Mar -> estimated true-up ~$6,400 per contract usage rates. If both apply, gross impact ~ $16.4k. I'll attach worksheets.
erin.finance: I'll re-run CLM search and check for any unsigned e-sign prompts or DocuSign envelope. Also check if finance approved a PO that referenced new pricing.
maya: Action list: erin -> confirm amendment/PO; ben -> draft credit memo and revised invoice if billing error; sam -> export ticket transcript and flag support agent convo; I'll loop legal. @cfo can we withhold payment until corrected?
cfo: @maya yes, place a hold and notify customer finance team. Offer 30-day hold while we reconcile; if it's our error issue credit. If they insist on payment, we'll accept but will re-credit in same billing cycle — prefer hold.
legal: Send the ticket transcript and any emailed confirmation. If support agent promoted Enterprise without signed amendment, that likely isn't a binding contract change. We'll review contract terms & acceptance language.
maya: Sent ticket link and invoice to legal + finance worksheets. Ben, ping when credit memo draft ready.
ben_ledger: Will do. Drafting now, ETA EOD. If legal confirms no amendment we'll issue credit memo CM-2026-018.
maya: Thanks all. I'll update thread once legal confirms. :thumbsup:
